features.name: credit_amount_per_month
features.description: Average credit amount per month of duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized measure of monthly financial burden, which helps tree models split on actual cash flow impact rather than just total amount.

features.name: age_bucket
features.description: Ordinal categorization of age into four distinct life stages.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups age into ordinal buckets, allowing tree models to easily isolate specific life stages without needing multiple splits.

features.name: is_high_credit_amount
features.description: Boolean indicator for credit amounts exceeding 5000.
features.expected_model_benefit: Flags large loans, providing a direct boolean split for high-value credit applications.

features.name: installment_duration_interaction
features.description: Product of installment commitment and loan duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the interaction between installment rate and loan duration, representing the total time-weighted commitment.

features.name: has_no_checking
features.description: Boolean indicator for applicants without a checking account.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates applicants without a checking account, a key categorical grouping for financial profiling.

features.name: is_young_and_renting
features.description: Boolean indicator for applicants under 30 who rent their housing.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies young applicants who rent, a non-linear interaction of age and housing status that tree models can use directly.

features.name: financial_stability_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall financial health based on savings status, checking status, and credit history.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, monotonic representation of financial stability, reducing the need for the tree to learn complex multi-way splits across several categorical variables.

features.name: loan_purpose_risk_profile
features.description: Evaluates the inherent riskiness of the loan purpose combined with the requested amount and duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates high-cardinality categorical purpose into an ordinal risk scale, simplifying splits for the tree model.

features.name: total_commitments
features.description: Sum of existing credits and number of dependents.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines existing credits and dependents into a single integer representing total structural commitments.

features.name: credit_per_age
features.description: Ratio of credit amount to applicant age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Calculates the ratio of credit amount to age, highlighting unusually large loans for younger individuals.

features.name: social_stability_indicator
features.description: Semantic evaluation of social and residential stability based on employment, housing, personal status, and residence duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple demographic and lifestyle factors into a single ordinal feature, providing a strong, unified signal for tree splits.

features.name: has_guarantor_or_coapplicant
features.description: Boolean indicator for the presence of a guarantor or co-applicant.
features.expected_model_benefit: Flags the presence of a guarantor or co-applicant, providing a direct boolean indicator of external financial backing.
